combathitboxaddon.group.items_xp.desc: Hitboxes for dropped items on the ground and floating experience orbs

combathitboxaddon.group.nether_raids.des: Blazes, ghasts, pillagers, breezes, and other hostile mobs

combathitboxaddon.option.enabled.desc: Master switch. When disabled, all hitboxes render without filtering.
Automatically keeps F3+B hitboxes on upon entering a world.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_eye_height: Render the red line indicating the entity eye level.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_look_vecto: Render the blue line indicating where the entity or player is looking.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_items.desc: Render hitboxes for items on the ground. Disabled by default for a clean screen.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_experience: Render hitboxes for floating experience orbs. Disabled by default to remove clutter.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_projectile: Global toggle for arrows, pearls, snowballs, and fireballs.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_hostile_mo: Global toggle for zombies, skeletons, creepers, etc.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_passive_mo: Global toggle for cows, sheep, villagers, etc.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_ambient_mo: Global toggle for bats, fish, squids.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_vehicles_a: Global toggle for boats, minecarts, crystals, and TNT.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_misc_entit: Render hitboxes for modded or misc entities.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_arrows.des: Render hitboxes for regular arrows in flight.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_spectral_a: Render hitboxes for glowing spectral arrows.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_fishing_bo: Render hitboxes for fishing line hooks.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_ender_pear: Render hitboxes for thrown ender pearls.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_potions.de: Render hitboxes for splash/lingering potions and exp bottles.
Hitboxes for ghast, blaze, and dragon fireballs.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_other_play: Render hitboxes for other players in multiplayer.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_self_playe: Render your own hitbox in 3rd person view. Disabled by default to prevent blocking vision.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_zombies.de: Hitboxes for regular zombies, husks, drowneds, zombie villagers.
Hitboxes for skeletons, strays, wither skeletons, and bogged (1.21).
combathitboxaddon.option.show_spiders.de: Hitboxes for spiders and cave spiders.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_piglins.de: Hitboxes for piglins, brutes, and zombified piglins.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_slimes.des: Hitboxes for slimes and magma cubes.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_breezes.de: Hitbox for the 1.21 trial chamber Breeze mob.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_bosses.des: Ender Dragon, Wither, Warden, Elder Guardian.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_pets_and_m: Horses, donkeys, mules, llamas, camels, wolves, cats, parrots.
Villagers, wandering traders, iron & snow golems.
combathitboxaddon.option.show_end_crysta: Hitboxes for End Crystals (essential for Crystal PvP).
combathitboxaddon.option.show_display_in: Technical display entities (text, block displays) and interaction entities.
combathitboxaddon.option.custom_list_is_: If ON, hitboxes only show for entities in the custom list. If OFF, the list acts as a blacklist.
combathitboxaddon.option.custom_entity_i: Comma- or space-separated list of entity IDs (e.g. minecraft:bat, minecraft:item, custommod:mob)
